page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard4.Ax.Flex.32-256 is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance based on Intel Xeon 6987C-P processors. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, accompanied by 256.0 GB of system memory. This hardware setup establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 4.0 GB of RAM for each virtual core.

The instance does not include integrated hardware accelerators or local NVMe storage. Because local disk storage is absent, persistent data operations and file storage require network-attached block volumes. Networking includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for direct connectivity.

The dense core count and 3.9 GHz clock rate deliver consistent multi-threaded compute capacity suitable for enterprise workloads that require proportional compute and memory capacity. VM.Standard4.Ax.Flex.32-256 is appropriate for enterprise backend applications, continuous integration pipelines, batch data processing, distributed microservices, and relational database hosting utilizing attached block storage.
